name: render-data-processor-workflow
description: Local development runner for the Customer Data Merge demo. Deployed services live in frontend/, typescript/, and python/.

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir typescript/workflows install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir typescript/api install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && concurrently -k -n workflow,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm run dev:workflow" "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:workflow: cd typescript/workflows && render workflows dev -- pnpm exec tsx src/main.ts
scripts.dev:api: cd typescript/api && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://customer_merge:customer_merge@localhost:5432/customer_merge RENDER_USE_LOCAL_DEV=true RENDER_API_KEY=local pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:web: cd frontend && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8002 pnpm run dev
